authority: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) / Ministry of Consumer Affairs

sources.title: Nodal Officer and Grievance Redressal
sources.summary: Every e-commerce entity must establish an adequate grievance redressal mechanism and appoint a Grievance Officer, acknowledging receipt of consumer complaints within 48 hours and redressing them within one month.

sources.title: Price and Refund Transparency
sources.summary: Marketplace e-commerce platforms must display total price including break-up of charges, mandatory ticket size, postage/delivery fees, refund policies, and terms of cancellation without ambiguous or hidden charges.

sources.title: Duties of Sellers on Marketplaces
sources.summary: No seller shall refuse to take back goods, or refuse to refund consideration paid for defective, deficient, or spurious goods, or if the goods delivered do not correspond with the description advertised.

sources.title: Prohibition of Unfair Trade Practices in E-Commerce
sources.summary: Entities shall not manipulate the price of goods or services to gain unreasonable profit or indulge in discriminatory pricing. Cancellation charges must not be disproportionate compared to costs incurred.
